Definition: nominative or accusative case neuter plural of G3778; these things:--+ afterward, follow, + hereafter, X him, the same, so, such, that, then, these, they, this, those, thus.
BiblicalUsage: The word is these things, the neuter plural of this. Jesus says the Gentiles seek after all these things, and your Father knoweth that ye have need of them; and He asks, Have ye understood all these things. At the grave of Lazarus He speaks these things, then cries with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these things is the hinge of Jesus' teaching: seek first the kingdom, and all these things shall be added.
